rationale: The stock gapped up ~17% on earnings and has already sold off sharply from the open ($286.97 to $271.23), sitting at only 28% of today's range with the 9-EMA far above at $287 and VWAP at $273.56 — price is in a disorderly post-gap compression with no clear directional structure. The spread is wide (83.7 bps), the last two 1-minute candles show extreme volatility and high volume, and the mixed fundamental picture (strong revenue but deteriorating margins) creates uncertainty about where price stabilizes. With no established intraday trend and chaotic price action in the opening minutes, the risk/reward for either direction is unfavorable.
